decisionBoundary: Smart Rules v8.4 owns contextual parsing, routing, lineup grammar, exact structural indexes, approved knowledge, diagnostics and fuzzy review policy.
The Smart Rules v7 source remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is invoked only as a verified compatibility subsystem.
A fuzzy-only channel result is never an automatic mapping.
Scheduled GitHub builds use a service account to read one private Google Sheet and create an ephemeral exact mapping snapshot; no mapping table is published, committed, or uploaded as an artifact.

Workflow 1 runs daily before publication and may also be dispatched manually; it evaluates previously unseen exact (server_id, stream_id) identities plus only allowlisted existing disabled REVIEW rows, and writes only bounded verified EPG-control decisions through terminal rereads and provider revalidation.

A new real-guide identity is enabled only through an allowlisted exact matcher method, one explicit matching market, one unambiguous real EPGShare ID, and a descriptor-bound same-source programme gate that begins within six hours and extends at least six hours; an explicitly enabled coverage-fallback lane may instead assign a bounded, per-stream local synthetic guide after real and native validation fail, while every other result stays disabled as REVIEW.

Durable alias memory is rebuilt from the private Sheet on every run: one enabled current human MANUAL or APPROVED EPGShare row may teach an exact alias/market target, while automatic evidence with exact deterministic or ai-verified-v2 provenance requires the identical target on at least two different servers which are present and unchanged; missing rows, provider drift, conflicts, dummy IDs and quarantined rows can never teach it, and the normal programme gate still applies.

Gemini receives only sanitized channel context and two to eight locally discovered exact candidates; it cannot invent an ID and can enable a row only when Gemini HIGH selects the same top target independently chosen by both fixed local rankers, all scores and margins pass, the exact descriptor-bound XML/TXT catalog and programme gates pass, and a terminal Sheet, Sync Alerts and provider reread remains unchanged; every other result stays REVIEW and AI failure never blocks deterministic work.

The manual backlog analyzer receives a short-lived Google Sheets read-only token, writes no remote state, rechecks the terminal private Sheet and alert fingerprints, emits only fixed-schema aggregate counts, uses server-local review clusters, and treats native and placeholder findings as advisory candidates rather than mapping authority; cross-provider learning remains confined to the sealed Smart Rules durable alias memory.

An explicit Server 2/3 REVIEW recheck may recover a fresh native EPG ID only from the current API or an exact numeric-stream and exact-name M3U join; API/M3U conflicts, manual edits, changed identities and OPEN alerts stay disabled, while every KEEP_PANEL write additionally requires an exact case-unique XMLTV ID, a whole-catalog unambiguous compatible display name, the strong current programme gate, and an immediate unchanged provider revalidation before writing. Server 1 is excluded from this lane.

OPEN entries in the private Sync Alerts tab quarantine possible stream-ID reuse in every effective snapshot until the mapping is corrected and the alert is explicitly marked RESOLVED; an apply run must preserve the exact matcher-time OPEN quarantine set through every mapping-write boundary and the terminal snapshot boundary.

Workflow 2 binds the final authoritative private Sheet snapshot, the effective post-quarantine snapshot, and a manifest by SHA-256; fixed row floors use authoritative runnable rows while only effective runnable rows may be published.

The combined XML and official text catalogs may differ only within the strict bounded-rollover limits; automatic approval uses their exact case-sensitive intersection, while drift, dummy, case-ambiguous, route-ambiguous and matcher-normalization-confusable IDs remain ineligible or block matching safely.
All EPGShare schedules are selected from one bounded-memory parse of ALL_SOURCES1 and sealed in a same-job SQLite spool for verified reuse by the output builder.
Server 1 never downloads, reads, or falls back to its native panel XMLTV; legacy native IDs remain quarantined until reviewed against EPGShare.
Servers 2 and 3 use native panel XMLTV only for explicit runtime-eligible panel rows.

Native Server 2/3 panels may declare only an inert tv DOCTYPE with no internal subset and at most the exact xmltv.dtd SYSTEM identifier; external DTDs and entities are never loaded, while EPGShare and generated outputs remain DTD-free.
The app guide retains schema v1 required fields and three-item programme tuples; personalization is emitted in a companion metadata file.

The icon layer is separate from channel matching; Workflow 2 privately binds exact stream identities to a private mapping URL, an exact approved portrait or a transparent movie or music symbol, a safe EPGShare source icon, or original category artwork, in that order.
Logo filenames are never fuzzy matched automatically.

Workflow 1 analyzes the eligible REVIEW scope but persists at most one explicit total cap of 0, 25, 100, 500, 2,500, or 5,000 rows across deterministic, native, synthetic, IGNORE, and strict AI lanes; the scheduled cap defaults to zero, Gemini is explicit opt-in, AI receives only remaining whole-cluster capacity, and every Google batch is independently reread and provider-revalidated. Workflow 2 refreshes afterward and deploys only fully validated staged output.
